channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The week's clearest wins are outside-capital commitments: Prisa Group's $77M dual-brand Hampton/Homewood hotel (with Hilton planning nine more Puerto Rico hotels), a $2B Cabo Rojo luxury development tied to Reuben Brothers and Aman, Toyota's $55M Toa Baja expansion, and Miami-based CVI.CHE 105's $10M Plaza Las Américas restaurant. Energy remains the main risk: New Fortress Energy's LNG supply interruption to San Juan units, the FOMB's order for a revised PREPA fiscal plan, and rising power costs hitting businesses. Economists at the FOMB symposium forecast stagnation for 2027 despite roughly $1.6B in announced pharma investment, and the abrupt closure and Chapter 11 filing of Encanto Restaurants after Yum! Brands ended its franchise relationship is a notable signal for outside brands operating on the island.
